arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong, aggressive vocal hooks emphasizing vocal presence over instrumental density.

event_markers.label: Strong vocal hook begins
event_markers.reason: Increase vocal energy for hook section

track_roles.drums: beat foundation with sparse rhythmic hits during verses, fuller play during hooks
track_roles.bass: support low end with minimal movement during verses, strong presence in hooks
track_roles.chords: background harmonic texture mostly subdued, slightly more prominent in hook
track_roles.melody: minimal melodic instrumentation to highlight vocals
track_roles.vocal: primary focus with aggressive delivery, main energy driver
track_roles.fx: subtle effects to enhance transitions and vocal presence

sensei_drum.brief: Create a sparse drum pattern for verses and a fuller aggressive beat for hooks emphasizing punch and rhythmic drive.

bass_generator.brief: Generate minimal bass parts during verses with stronger, prominent bass lines during hooks to deepen the groove.

harmony_generator.brief: Add subtle harmonic textures to reinforce the mood, more present during hooks but restrained throughout.

melody_generator.brief: Keep melodic instrumentation minimal to keep focus on vocals, introduce slight motifs during hooks.

ai_designer.brief: Ensure overall balance prioritizes vocal clarity and aggression with sparse instrumental support.

presetor.brief: Set presets tailored for aggressive, vocal-focused Memphis Rap sound with clear vocal presence and punchy drums.

songgps.brief: Guide arrangement energy to reflect sparse verses and strong hooks focusing on vocal dominance.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed channel audio with clean vocal focus and balanced mix ready for final mastering.
